# openobserve_alert_template (Data Source)

Reads an existing alert template, including the prebuilt templates OpenObserve ships with.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reuse a prebuilt template that ships with OpenObserve.
data "openobserve_alert_template" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

resource "openobserve_alert_destination" "webhook" {
  name     = "ops-webhook"
  url      = var.webhook_url
  template = data.openobserve_alert_template.default.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Template name to look up.

### Optional

- `org_id` (String) Organization identifier. Defaults to the provider's `org_id`.

### Read-Only

- `body` (String) Message body.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the format `{org_id}/{name}`.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the organization's default template.
- `is_prebuilt` (Boolean) Whether the template is system-managed and read-only.
- `title` (String) Email subject line, for email templates.
- `type` (String) Channel the template renders for.
